'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matt Sokol DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
